articles.official_title_or_gist_ko: 받침 ‘ㄲ, ㅋ’, ‘ㅅ, ㅆ, ㅈ, ㅊ, ㅌ’, ‘ㅍ’은 어말 또는 자음 앞에서 각각 대표음 [ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ]으로 발음한다. (no 붙임/다만)
problems: pron.final says consonants are pronounced as one of seven sounds (ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ). That is the content of 제8항 (7 representative sounds, which I did NOT open; stated from knowledge, unverified here), not 제9항. 제9항 only maps ㄲㅋ, ㅅㅆㅈㅊㅌ, ㅍ to [ㄱ ㄷ ㅂ] at word end or before a consonant, which the code (NEUTRALISED set) implements correctly.
Example 부엌[부억] is not in the 제9항 example list (official has 키읔[키윽]); it is a valid application but not an official example. 옷[옫] is official.
Tip says 'end of a syllable'; article says 어말 또는 자음 앞.
articles.suggested_fix: Reword to the 제9항 content: 'At the end of a word or before a consonant, ㄲ ㅋ ㅅ ㅆ ㅈ ㅊ ㅌ ㅍ are pronounced as ㄱ, ㄷ or ㅂ', or cite 제8–9항 if keeping 'seven sounds'. Use official example 옷[옫] and 키읔[키윽] or 꽃[꼳] instead of 부엌[부억].

articles.official_title_or_gist_ko: 홑받침이나 쌍받침이 모음으로 시작된 조사나 어미, 접미사와 결합되는 경우에는, 제 음가대로 뒤 음절 첫소리로 옮겨 발음한다. (no 붙임/다만)
problems: Tip says any final consonant before an ㅇ-initial syllable moves over. Article 13 is limited to single/double (홑·쌍) finals before a vowel-initial 조사, 어미 or 접미사. Clusters (겹받침) are 제14항 and vowel-initial 실질형태소 (e.g. 겉옷, 맛없다) are 제15항 (not opened; stated from knowledge, unverified).
Code (pronTipFor) fires for any tail except 0, 21 (ㅇ), 27 (ㅎ), so it also fires for clusters and compounds where 제13항 does not apply (e.g. 몫이, 맛있다).
articles.suggested_fix: Add the condition 'when followed by a particle, ending or suffix beginning with a vowel' and 'single or double final consonant' to the tip text, and restrict code to tails of single/double consonants (1,2,4,7,8,16,17,19,20,22,23,24,25,26), or reword/cite 제13–14항.

articles.official_title_or_gist_ko: 받침 ㄱ(ㄲ ㅋ ㄳ ㄺ), ㄷ(ㅅ ㅆ ㅈ ㅊ ㅌ ㅎ), ㅂ(ㅍ ㄼ ㄿ ㅄ)은 ‘ㄴ, ㅁ’ 앞에서 [ㅇ, ㄴ, ㅁ]으로 발음한다. 붙임: 두 단어를 이어서 한 마디로 발음하는 경우에도 이와 같다.
problems: Minor: code STOP_FINALS omits ㄺ (9), ㄼ (11), ㄿ (14) and ㅎ (27), which the article includes (false negatives only, no wrong tip). Tip text 'k, t or p type' is an accurate gloss.
articles.suggested_fix: Optional: add 9, 11, 14, 27 to the nasal trigger set (not to the tense set for 27; 제23항 has no ㅎ).

articles.official_title_or_gist_ko: ‘ㄴ’은 ‘ㄹ’의 앞이나 뒤에서 [ㄹ]로 발음한다. 붙임: 첫소리 ‘ㄴ’이 ‘ㅀ’, ‘ㄾ’ 뒤에 연결되는 경우에도 이에 준한다. 다만: 의견란[의ː견난] 등은 [ㄴㄴ]으로 발음한다.
problems: Tip is a correct statement of the main rule (ㄴ adjacent to ㄹ, either order, is pronounced ㄹ) but gives no 다만 exceptions: 의견란, 생산량, 공권력, 동원령, 상견례, 횡단로, 이원론, 입원료, 구근류 keep [ㄴㄴ]. The code fires on every ㄴ+ㄹ-initial and ㄹ+ㄴ-initial pair, so these words would get a tip that contradicts the official pronunciation.
Code does not cover the 붙임 (ㅀ/ㄾ + ㄴ: 닳는, 뚫는, 핥네) — false negatives only.
articles.suggested_fix: Either add a blocklist of the 다만 words (의견란, 임진란, 생산량, 결단력, 공권력, 동원령, 상견례, 횡단로, 이원론, 입원료, 구근류) so no lateral tip is shown for them, or soften the tip text ('mostly; a few Sino-Korean words such as 의견란[의견난] are exceptions').

articles.official_title_or_gist_ko: 받침 ㄱ(ㄲ ㅋ ㄳ ㄺ), ㄷ(ㅅ ㅆ ㅈ ㅊ ㅌ), ㅂ(ㅍ ㄼ ㄿ ㅄ) 뒤에 연결되는 ‘ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ, ㅅ, ㅈ’은 된소리로 발음한다. (no 붙임/다만)
problems: Rule description (stop final then ㄱ ㄷ ㅂ ㅅ ㅈ becomes tense) matches. Initial set in code (leads 0,3,7,9,12) is correct.
닫고[닫꼬] is not in the official example list (it is a correct application; official has 꽂고[꼳꼬]). 국밥[국빱] is official. The article's ㄷ group does NOT include ㅎ, and code correctly excludes tail 27.
Code omits finals ㄺ (9), ㄼ (11), ㄿ (14) (false negatives only). Caveat: 제24–27항 (verb stems ㄴ ㅁ, ㄼ/ㄾ, etc.) are separate and not opened.
articles.suggested_fix: Replace 닫고[닫꼬] with an official example such as 꽂고[꼳꼬] or 옷고름[옫꼬름] (or keep 국밥[국빱] only). Optionally add tails 9, 11, 14 to the set.

unverified: 제8항 (7 representative sounds) text was not opened; the claim that 'seven sounds' belongs to 제8항 is from prior knowledge.
제14항 and 제15항 text not opened.
